overall.summary: Mostly reproduces; refuted on one technical number (a voice-mail plan is said to move the logit by -2.37; the model gives -1.96), and three sentences round 4.45% up to about 5%.

findings.statement: relay 2377, 12977 -> 5868 -> 7162 always on; rare-state leaf no measurable effect
findings.evidence: all four relay nodes active on 4000/4000 rows; mean-ablating ann_82 AUC 0.9095 -> 0.9094

uv run python -m explaneat verify ablate experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-274350 --part ann_82 --to mean

findings.check: probe voice-mail plan 0 -> 1 at the typical customer (no part changes)
findings.evidence: the score falls by 1.96 logit (-3.765 -> -5.722), all from the direct edge, which matches -0.86/SD x 2.27 SD = -1.95; -2.37 does not reproduce. (International plan: +2.61 direct against the stated +2.67, close.)
